from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LoansAndAdvances(BaseModel):
    """A single financial report entry for Gree Electric containing loans and advances data."""
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The full report period as named (e.g., '2015年第三季度', '2024年第一季度')")
    report_year: int | None = Field(description="The year of this report for chronological ordering")
    beginning_balance: float | None = Field(description="Beginning balance of loans and advances at start of period (in yuan)")
    ending_balance: float | None = Field(description="Ending balance of loans and advances at end of period (in yuan)")
    net_change_amount: float | None = Field(description="Net increase/decrease in customer loans and advances from cash flow statement (in yuan)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    loans_and_advances: list[LoansAndAdvances]
